text.text: Built from a small blade, hammer head, large plate and tough handle. Hold right click and move to strike ahead; mounting is optional. Horizontal motion increases charge damage; holding use does not propel you.

Each target can be hit once per charge, costing 10 extra durability per successful hit. The first hit starts a fixed 40-tick window; later hits do not extend it. Release and use again to begin a new charge. Targets require line of sight.
